NULL
, #{bankName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{accountHolder,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )

mapper.sql:
WHERE 1 = 1
AND m.DELETEDAT IS NOT NULL
AND m.DELETEDAT IS NULL AND m.STATUS = #{memberStatus}
AND TO_CHAR(m.MEMBERID) LIKE '%' || #{kwd} || '%'
AND INSTR(d.NAME, #{kwd}) > 0
AND INSTR(d.USERID, #{kwd}) > 0
AND INSTR(d.PHONE, #{kwd}) > 0
AND INSTR(d.EMAIL, #{kwd}) > 0
AND ( INSTR(m.STATUS, #{kwd}) > 0 OR (m.DELETEDAT IS NOT NULL AND INSTR('삭제', #{kwd}) > 0) )
AND ( TO_CHAR(m.MEMBERID) LIKE '%' || #{kwd} || '%' OR INSTR(d.NAME, #{kwd}) > 0 OR INSTR(d.USERID, #{kwd}) > 0 OR INSTR(d.PHONE, #{kwd}) > 0 OR INSTR(d.EMAIL, #{kwd}) > 0 OR INSTR(m.STATUS, #{kwd}) > 0 OR (m.DELETEDAT IS NOT NULL AND INSTR('삭제', #{kwd}) > 0) )
mapper.select:
SELECT m.MEMBERID, m.ROLE, m.STATUS, TO_CHAR(m.CREATEDAT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS createAt, TO_CHAR(m.DELETEDAT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS deleteAt, d.USERID, d.NAME, d.EMAIL, d.PHONE, TO_CHAR(d.BIRTH, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS birth, TO_CHAR(d.UPDATEDAT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS updateAt, d.REFUNDACCOUNT, d.BANKNAME, d.ACCOUNTHOLDER, a.ZIPCODE AS zip, a.ADDR1, a.ADDR2 FROM MEMBER m JOIN MEMBERDETAIL d ON m.MEMBERID = d.MEMBERID LEFT JOIN ADDRESS a ON a.ADDRESSID = ( SELECT MIN(a2.ADDRESSID) FROM ADDRESS a2 WHERE a2.MEMBERID = m.MEMBERID AND LOWER(a2.ISDEFAULT) = 'yes' )
ORDER BY m.MEMBERID DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{size} ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MEMBER m JOIN MEMBERDETAIL d ON m.MEMBERID = d.MEMBERID
mapper.update: UPDATE MEMBER SET ROLE = #{role}, STATUS = #{status,jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE MEMBERID = #{memberId} AND DELETEDAT IS NULL

MERGE INTO ADDRESS a USING (SELECT #{memberId} AS MEMBERID FROM dual) src ON (a.MEMBERID = src.MEMBERID AND LOWER(a.ISDEFAULT) = 'yes') WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET a.RECEIVER = #{name}, a.RECEIVERNO = TO_NUMBER(REPLACE(#{phone}, '-', '')), a.ADDR1 = #{addr1}, a.ADDR2 = #{addr2,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, a.ZIPCODE = #{zip} WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (ADDRESSID, MEMBERID, RECEIVER, RECEIVERNO, ADDR1, ADDR2, ZIPCODE, ISDEFAULT) VALUES ( ADDRESS_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{memberId}, #{name}, TO_NUMBER(REPLACE(#{phone}, '-', '')), #{addr1}, #{addr2,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{zip}, 'yes' )
UPDATE MEMBER SET DELETEDAT = SYSDATE WHERE MEMBERID = #{memberId} AND DELETEDAT IS NULL
UPDATE MEMBER SET STATUS = '일반', DELETEDAT = NULL WHERE MEMBERID = #{memberId} AND DELETEDAT IS NOT NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MEMBER_SANCTION ( SANCTIONID, MEMBERID, REASON, STARTDATE, ENDDATE, STATUS ) VALUES ( MEMBER_SANCTION_SEQ.NEXTVAL, #{memberId}, #{sanctionReason}, SYSDATE, NULL, '진행중' )
mapper.update: UPDATE MEMBER_SANCTION SET STATUS = '해제', ENDDATE = SYSDATE WHERE MEMBERID = #{memberId} AND STATUS = '진행중'
UPDATE MEMBER SET STATUS = '접속불가' WHERE MEMBERID = #{memberId} AND DELETEDAT IS NULL
UPDATE MEMBER SET STATUS = '일반' WHERE MEMBERID = #{memberId} AND DELETEDAT IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT m.MEMBERID AS memberId, d.USERID AS userId, d.NAME AS name, m.STATUS AS status FROM MEMBER m JOIN MEMBERDETAIL d ON m.MEMBERID = d.MEMBERID WHERE m.MEMBERID = #{memberId} AND m.DELETEDAT IS NULL

SELECT m.MEMBERID AS "memberId", d.NAME AS "name", d.USERID AS "userId", NVL( MAX(p.BALANCE) KEEP ( DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY p.UPDATEDAT, p.POINTID ), 0 ) AS "balance", NVL(SUM( CASE WHEN p.TYPE IN ('사용', '차감', 'USE', 'DEDUCT', 'MINUS') THEN 0 WHEN p.AMOUNT > 0 THEN p.AMOUNT ELSE 0 END ), 0) AS "totalEarn", NVL(SUM( CASE WHEN p.TYPE IN ('사용', '차감', 'USE', 'DEDUCT', 'MINUS') THEN ABS(p.AMOUNT) WHEN p.AMOUNT < 0 THEN ABS(p.AMOUNT) ELSE 0 END ), 0) AS "totalUsed", TO_CHAR(MAX(p.UPDATEDAT), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "lastUpdatedAt" FROM MEMBER m JOIN MEMBERDETAIL d ON d.MEMBERID = m.MEMBERID LEFT JOIN POINTLOG p ON p.MEMBERID = TO_CHAR(m.MEMBERID) WHERE m.DELETEDAT IS NULL
AND TO_CHAR(m.MEMBERID) LIKE '%' || #{pointKwd} || '%'
AND INSTR(d.NAME, #{pointKwd}) > 0
AND INSTR(d.USERID, #{pointKwd}) > 0
AND ( TO_CHAR(m.MEMBERID) LIKE '%' || #{pointKwd} || '%' OR INSTR(d.NAME, #{pointKwd}) > 0 OR INSTR(d.USERID, #{pointKwd}) > 0 )
GROUP BY m.MEMBERID, d.NAME, d.USERID ORDER BY m.MEMBERID DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MEMBER m JOIN MEMBERDETAIL d ON d.MEMBERID = m.MEMBERID WHERE m.DELETEDAT IS NULL
AND TO_CHAR(m.MEMBERID) LIKE '%' || #{pointKwd} || '%'
AND INSTR(d.NAME, #{pointKwd}) > 0
AND INSTR(d.USERID, #{pointKwd}) > 0
AND ( TO_CHAR(m.MEMBERID) LIKE '%' || #{pointKwd} || '%' OR INSTR(d.NAME, #{pointKwd}) > 0 OR INSTR(d.USERID, #{pointKwd}) > 0 )

SELECT p.POINTID AS "pointId", p.ORDERID AS "orderId", p.MEMBERID AS "memberId", d.NAME AS "name", d.USERID AS "userId", p.AMOUNT AS "amount", p.TYPE AS "type", p.REASON AS "reason", p.BALANCE AS "balance", TO_CHAR(p.UPDATEDAT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "updatedAt", TO_CHAR(p.EXPIREDAT, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "expiredAt" FROM POINTLOG p LEFT JOIN MEMBERDETAIL d ON TO_CHAR(d.MEMBERID) = p.MEMBERID WHERE p.MEMBERID = TO_CHAR(#{memberId}) ORDER BY p.UPDATEDAT DESC, p.POINTID DESC
SELECT NVL(( SELECT BALANCE FROM ( SELECT BALANCE FROM POINTLOG WHERE MEMBERID = TO_CHAR(#{memberId}) ORDER BY UPDATEDAT DESC, POINTID DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1 ), 0) FROM dual
SELECT NVL(MAX(POINTID), 0) + 1 FROM POINTLOG
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO POINTLOG ( POINTID, ORDERID, MEMBERID, AMOUNT, TYPE, REASON, BALANCE, UPDATEDAT, EXPIREDAT ) VALUES ( #{pointId}, #{orderId}, TO_CHAR(#{memberId}), #{amount}, #{type}, #{reason}, #{balance}, SYSDATE, NULL )
mapper.select:
SELECT c.COUPONID AS "couponId", c.NAME AS "name", TO_CHAR(c.VALIDDAYS, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "validDays", c.DISCOUNT AS "discount", c.DISCOUNTTYPE AS "discountType", c.MINORDERAMOUNT AS "minOrderAmount", c.MAXDISCOUNTAMOUNT AS "maxDiscountAmount", c.AVAILABILITY AS "availability", COUNT(uc.MEMBERCOUPONID) AS "issuedCount" FROM COUPON c LEFT JOIN USERCOUPONS uc ON uc.COUPONID = c.COUPONID WHERE 1 = 1
AND c.AVAILABILITY = #{couponStatus}
AND TO_CHAR(c.COUPONID) LIKE '%' || #{couponKwd} || '%'
AND INSTR(c.NAME, #{couponKwd}) > 0
AND ( TO_CHAR(c.COUPONID) LIKE '%' || #{couponKwd} || '%' OR INSTR(c.NAME, #{couponKwd}) > 0 OR INSTR(c.DISCOUNTTYPE, #{couponKwd}) > 0 OR INSTR(c.AVAILABILITY, #{couponKwd}) > 0 )
GROUP BY c.COUPONID, c.NAME, c.VALIDDAYS, c.DISCOUNT, c.DISCOUNTTYPE, c.MINORDERAMOUNT, c.MAXDISCOUNTAMOUNT, c.AVAILABILITY ORDER BY c.COUPONID DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COUPON c WHERE 1 = 1
AND c.AVAILABILITY = #{couponStatus}
AND TO_CHAR(c.COUPONID) LIKE '%' || #{couponKwd} || '%'
AND INSTR(c.NAME, #{couponKwd}) > 0
AND ( TO_CHAR(c.COUPONID) LIKE '%' || #{couponKwd} || '%' OR INSTR(c.NAME, #{couponKwd}) > 0 OR INSTR(c.DISCOUNTTYPE, #{couponKwd}) > 0 OR INSTR(c.AVAILABILITY, #{couponKwd}) > 0 )
SELECT NVL(MAX(COUPONID), 0) + 1 FROM COUPON
mapper.update: UPDATE COUPON SET NAME = #{name}, VALIDDAYS = TO_DATE(#{validDays}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), DISCOUNT = #{discount}, DISCOUNTTYPE = #{discountType}, MINORDERAMOUNT = #{minOrderAmount,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, MAXDISCOUNTAMOUNT = #{maxDiscountAmount,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, AVAILABILITY = #{availability} WHERE COUPONID = #{couponId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM COUPON c WHERE c.COUPONID = #{couponId} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM USERCOUPONS uc WHERE uc.COUPONID = c.COUPONID )
mapper.select: SELECT NVL(MAX(MEMBERCOUPONID), 0) + 1 FROM USERCOUPONS
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO USERCOUPONS ( MEMBERCOUPONID, COUPONID, MEMBERID, ORDERID, ISSUED, ISSUEDAT, USEDAT, EXPIREDAT ) SELECT #{memberCouponId}, c.COUPONID, #{memberId}, NULL, 'Y', SYSDATE, NULL, c.VALIDDAYS FROM COUPON c WHERE c.COUPONID = #{couponId} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM USERCOUPONS uc WHERE uc.COUPONID = c.COUPONID AND uc.MEMBERID = #{memberId} AND uc.ISSUED = 'Y' AND uc.USEDAT IS NULL AND (uc.EXPIREDAT IS NULL OR uc.EXPIREDAT >= TRUNC(SYSDATE)) )
